event_gate: exact completed daily MACD bullish cross plus archived long-trend qualification

family_definitions.support_location: any frozen support-location evidence; duplicate hits count once
family_definitions.controlled_pullback: 60-day pullback plus at least two of four train-frozen quality votes
family_definitions.reacceleration: at least two of five momentum, volume, directional, candle or confirmation votes
family_definitions.low_supply_risk: at least three of five overhead, flow, price-volume, squeeze and downside-risk guards

method.search_surface: all non-empty AND combinations; no raw-factor subset or weight search

decision.reason: This is the highest-return adequately sampled historical combination, but it failed one or more frozen robustness gates and cannot enter scoring.

not_applicable_execution_metrics.reason: This is an overlapping event-level fixed-hold factor experiment without capital allocation, stop, target or active exit rules.

limitations: 2025 and 2026 have already been reviewed and are seen-period rechecks, not independent validation
historical delisted and ticker-change coverage remains partial
historical industry membership is unavailable and excluded
matching reduces measured imbalance but cannot establish causality
event-level results are not a capital-constrained portfolio
